media.title: AI-generated 3D food assets rendered in a native iOS calorie tracker

title: Take AI-Generated 3D Assets from 10 to 120 FPS with Metal
summary: Anshu Chimala explains an AI-assisted pipeline that turns generated food images into groomed Gaussian splats for a native iOS calorie tracker. He reports replacing separate MTKViews with one full-screen CAMetalLayer and optimizing point sorting to raise performance from roughly 10 to 120 FPS; an iOS team can profile asset generation and rendering as one system before choosing its view architecture.
takeaway: Profile generated assets on-device early; if separate render views create unacceptable overhead, test a shared Metal layer and measure culling, sorting, memory, and frame rate together.
